_meta.description: Compiled Nexora SAGE architecture doctrine from modular doctrine packs

relative_imports_no_alias.label: Canonical Alias Boundary Bypass
relative_imports_no_alias.rationale: When a JavaScript or TypeScript workspace exposes a canonical path alias, local path imports that cross its safe within-module relative boundary must use that alias; package imports, alias-free workspaces, safe within-module relatives and declared asset side effects remain outside this rule.

loc_limits_hook.label: LOC Hook > limit
loc_limits_hook.rationale: Oversized hooks are a broadly applicable maintainability smell.

loc_limits_component.label: LOC Oversized Component > limit
loc_limits_component.rationale: Oversized components are maintainability review signals; bounded source evidence must determine the correction strategy.

loc_limits_symbol.label: LOC Oversized Non-Component Symbol > limit
loc_limits_symbol.rationale: Oversized non-component symbols are maintainability review signals; the exact symbol kind and bounded source evidence determine whether decomposition is warranted.

loc_limits_service.label: LOC Service > limit
loc_limits_service.rationale: Oversized service surfaces usually indicate poor decomposition regardless of repo style.

deep_imports.label: Cross-Module Deep Imports
deep_imports.rationale: This is most meaningful when the workspace follows module-rooted FSD-style boundaries.

own_api_imports.label: Own API Imports
own_api_imports.rationale: API-surface import discipline depends on a module/public-API architecture.

relative_module_escapes.label: Relative Module Escapes (../)
relative_module_escapes.rationale: Module escape semantics only become strong signals when bounded module roots exist.

fsd_shared_features.label: FSD Shared->Features Leaks
fsd_shared_features.rationale: This rule is specific to Feature-Sliced Design style layering.

domain_ui_leaks.label: Domain UI Leaks
domain_ui_leaks.rationale: Domain-to-UI purity is meaningful when domain/application layering exists.

domain_platform_leaks.label: Domain Platform Leaks
domain_platform_leaks.rationale: Domain/platform purity is architecture-sensitive rather than universally applicable.

impure_stores.label: Impure Stores
impure_stores.rationale: Entity-store purity matters when entities/stores are first-class architectural concepts.

zustand_no_selector.label: Zustand Store Missing Selector/Shallow
zustand_no_selector.rationale: This rule is only meaningful in repositories that actually use Zustand.

banned_i18n.label: Banned i18n Usage
banned_i18n.rationale: i18n policy is typically a repo-specific governance choice.

hexagonal_layer_violation.label: Hexagonal Layer Violation
hexagonal_layer_violation.rationale: Enforces strict layering (e.g., infra must not depend on application directly).

impure_entities.label: Impure Entities/Store (React Leak)
impure_entities.rationale: Entities and stores should remain pure and headless, free from UI library dependencies.

typescript.reason: TS Adapters must not depend on orchestration

python.reason: Python Domain logic must be framework-free
Python Adapters must not pollute domain models

java.reason: Java Domain must remain decoupled from DB adapters

forbidden_mappings.reason: Adapters must not depend on orchestration

relative_imports_no_alias.action: Replace the local path import with the workspace canonical alias when it crosses the safe within-module relative boundary.

loc_limits_hook.action: Split oversized hooks into orchestrator + focused sub-hooks.

loc_limits_component.action: Split oversized implementations along existing responsibilities; keep public contracts stable and avoid creating shallow helper files.

loc_limits_symbol.action: Review the reported symbol kind and bounded source evidence, then split only along demonstrated responsibilities while preserving the public contract.
